description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to cryptographic proof sources for QUIC, including certificate chains, signatures, and proof verification mechanisms.

classes.name: CryptoBuffers
classes.description: RAII class managing a vector of CRYPTO_BUFFER pointers.

classes.name: ProofSource
classes.description: Interface for obtaining certificate chains and signatures for QUIC.

classes.name: ProofSource::Chain
classes.description: Reference-counted wrapper for a vector of stringified certificates.

classes.name: ProofSource::Details
classes.description: Abstract container for implementation-specific details returned by ProofSource.

classes.name: ProofSource::Callback
classes.description: Callback interface for async GetProof results.

classes.name: ProofSource::SignatureCallback
classes.description: Callback interface for async ComputeTlsSignature results.

classes.name: ProofSource::TicketCrypter
classes.description: Interface for managing encryption/decryption of TLS session tickets.

classes.name: ProofSourceHandleCallback
classes.description: Interface for callbacks when ProofSourceHandle operations complete.

classes.name: ProofSourceHandle
classes.description: Interface for per-handshaker certificate and signature operations.

methods.name: CryptoBuffers::~CryptoBuffers
methods.description: Destructor for CryptoBuffers, releases owned buffers.

methods.name: ProofSource::Chain::Chain
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a vector of certificates.

methods.name: ProofSource::GetProof
methods.description: Asynchronously obtains a certificate chain and signature for a hostname.

methods.name: ProofSource::GetCertChain
methods.description: Returns the certificate chain for a hostname.

methods.name: ProofSource::ComputeTlsSignature
methods.description: Computes a signature for given data using the private key.

methods.name: ProofSource::GetTicketCrypter
methods.description: Returns the TicketCrypter for session ticket encryption/decryption.

methods.name: ProofSourceHandleCallback::OnSelectCertificateDone
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of certificate selection.

methods.name: ProofSourceHandleCallback::OnComputeSignatureDone
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of signature computation.

methods.name: ProofSourceHandle::CloseHandle
methods.description: Cancels pending operations and closes the handle.
